working_definition: TmY3 is a narrow-field transmedullary Y neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. It extends through the medulla (arborizations in layers M1, M2, M4-M6, M8, M10) then splits at the second optic chiasm to innervate lobula layer 4 and lobula plate layer 4 with bleb-type terminals. It is cholinergic.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y neuron that terminates with bleb-type arborizations in lobula layers 4 and lobula plate layer 4. It displays fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M4, M5, M6, M8, and M10, and has bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M5 and M10. It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt:00003820 'transmedullary Y neuron TmY3' matches the cluster label verbatim and its definition precisely describes the same cell type: a TmY-class optic lobe neuron with bleb-type terminals in lobula layer 4 and lobula plate layer 4, fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M4-M6, M8 and M10, and cholinergic neurotransmitter identity. The atlas cluster label 'TmY3' is the canonical anatomical name, not a driver or marker alias. The term is not obsolete. The immature form (FBbt:00052337) is excluded as the atlas dataset is adult tissue.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY3 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Immature/developing stage term; Kurmangaliyev 2020 is an adult optic lobe atlas, so the adult form (FBbt:00003820) is the appropriate match.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron that terminates in lobula layer 4 with bleb-like terminal arborizations. It has fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M4, and M5, and has bleb-type arborization in medulla layers M1, M4, M9 and M10. It differs from the transmedullary neuron Tm3 or TmY3 in that an individual of a retinotopic set may or may not form branches in the lobula plate.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Distinct type explicitly contrasted with TmY3 in its own FBbt definition; differs in medulla layer pattern and variable lobula plate innervation. Not the same cell type.

recommendation: Map cluster TmY3 to FBbt:00003820 (transmedullary Y neuron TmY3) as skos:exactMatch. The label, layer-by-layer morphology, and cholinergic identity all agree precisely. No new term is needed and no further verification is required.
